query: So, how do I sign up for the Tamil Nadu Police's dog handler job?
reference_answer:
Tamil Nadu Police Dog Handler Positions:
To apply, visit the Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board (TNUSRB) website for notifications. Meet the eligibility criteria, fill out the online application, and appear for the written exam and physical tests.
answer: To sign up for the Tamil Nadu Police's dog handler job, visit the official Tamil Nadu Police recruitment website and look for the section dedicated to dog handler positions. Follow the online application process which includes filling out an application form and attending a selection test. [Document 1]
